name: Vault 13
experiment: Intended to stay sealed for 200 years to study long-term isolation
outcome: Opened early due to water chip failure. Vault Dweller saved wasteland from the Master.

name: Vault 111
outcome: All residents except one killed or remained frozen. Sole Survivor emerged 210 years after the war.

name: Vault 101
experiment: Never intended to open, test of indefinite isolation
outcome: Lone Wanderer escaped, leading to political upheaval within the vault.

name: Vault 76
experiment: Control vault, intended to open after 20-25 years
outcome: Successfully opened in 2102, residents tasked with rebuilding America.

name: Vault 81
experiment: Test experimental diseases on residents without their knowledge
outcome: Scientists refused to conduct experiments, vault thriving as isolated community.

name: Vault 11
experiment: Residents must sacrifice one person annually or face extermination
outcome: After years of sacrifices, final residents refused and vault opened, revealing it was a test of morality.

name: Vault 112
experiment: Virtual reality simulation under control of Stanislaus Braun
outcome: Residents trapped in endless VR simulation, tortured by sadistic overseer for 200 years.

name: Vault 22
outcome: Plant experiments went wrong, creating deadly spore carriers that killed all residents.
